name: Strategy and planning
description: Information security governance: policy set, roles and accountability, management commitment, planning and resourcing of the security programme.
evidence: Approved security policy, security organisation chart, programme plan and budget, management review minutes.

name: Information security risk management
description: Risk assessment method, risk register, treatment decisions, risk acceptance and periodic re-assessment.
evidence: Risk methodology, current risk register, treatment plan, risk acceptance records.

name: Awareness and training
description: Security awareness for everyone, role-based training for staff with security duties, and measurement of both.
evidence: Awareness plan, completion rates, phishing simulation results, training records for privileged roles.

name: Human resources security
description: Screening, terms of employment, duties during employment, disciplinary process and responsibilities when people leave or change role.
evidence: Screening procedure, signed terms and confidentiality agreements, joiner/mover/leaver checklist.

name: Compliance
description: Identification of legal, regulatory and contractual obligations, protection of records and personal data, and verification that policies are followed.
evidence: Register of obligations, records retention schedule, privacy notices, internal compliance checks.

name: Performance evaluation and improvement
description: Monitoring and measurement of the programme, internal audit, management review and corrective action.
evidence: Security metrics, internal audit programme and reports, corrective action log, management review outputs.

name: Asset management
description: Inventory and ownership of information and assets, acceptable use, classification and labelling, handling and return of assets.
evidence: Asset inventory with owners, classification scheme, acceptable use policy, media disposal records.

name: Physical and environmental security
description: Secure areas, physical entry control, protection against environmental threats, equipment siting, maintenance and secure disposal.
evidence: Access logs for secure areas, visitor records, environmental monitoring, maintenance and disposal records.

name: Operations management
description: Documented operating procedures, change management, capacity, malware protection, vulnerability and patch management, configuration, backup, logging and monitoring.
evidence: Operating procedures, change records, patch compliance report, backup test results, log retention settings.

name: Communications
description: Network security and segregation, security of network services, information transfer, cryptography and data leakage prevention.
evidence: Network diagram with zones, firewall rule review, encryption standard, transfer agreements, DLP policy.

name: Access control
description: Access control policy, identity lifecycle, authentication, privileged access, access rights review and secure authentication.
evidence: Access control policy, joiner/mover/leaver evidence, MFA coverage, privileged account inventory, access review sign-offs.

name: Third-party security
description: Security in supplier relationships: requirements in agreements, supply chain, monitoring and review of supplier services, cloud services.
evidence: Supplier inventory with tiering, security clauses in contracts, supplier assessments, service review records.

name: Information systems acquisition, development and maintenance
description: Security requirements for new systems, secure development lifecycle, test data, outsourced development, change and acceptance testing.
evidence: Security requirements checklist, secure coding standard, code review and test results, environment separation.

name: Information security incident management
description: Incident response planning, reporting of events and weaknesses, assessment and decision, response, lessons learned and evidence collection.
evidence: Incident response plan, incident register, post-incident reviews, regulator notification records.

name: Information systems continuity management
description: Continuity planning for ICT, redundancy, recovery objectives, testing and maintenance of continuity arrangements.
evidence: Business impact analysis, ICT continuity plan with RTO/RPO, test reports, redundancy design.
